zh.group1Title: 1 · 官方几何（每格右边是现测读数）
zh.group1Label: 判定 CT-MF-01 / 02 / 03：Button 只允许 36 或 28 高、圆角只允许 12 或 8（`--dsw-radius-md` / `--dsw-radius-sm`）；Switch 只允许 36 × 20；Button 内图标容器 16 × 16
zh.group2Label: hover / focus-visible 是真的伪类，把指针移上去或按 Tab 进来就是真效果；左边三个静态格子用类强制成同一帧，方便并排看
zh.group3Title: 3 · 反例：这三样按 CT-MF-11 / CT-MF-12 判缺陷
zh.verdictRole: role=button 却不可聚焦、无键盘处理
zh.verdictOverridden: 覆盖官方几何：高 44、圆角 22、字号 16

en.group1Title: 1 · Official geometry (each cell's live readout sits on the right)
en.group1Label: Judging CT-MF-01 / 02 / 03: a Button may only be 36 or 28 tall, with a corner radius of only 12 or 8 (`--dsw-radius-md` / `--dsw-radius-sm`); a Switch only 36 × 20; the icon slot inside a Button 16 × 16
en.group2Label: hover / focus-visible are real pseudo-classes: move the pointer over it or Tab into it and you get the real effect; the three static cells on the left force the same frame with classes, so they can be compared side by side
en.group3Title: 3 · Counter-examples: these three fail CT-MF-11 / CT-MF-12
en.fakeButton: A div posing as a button
en.verdictRole: role=button but not focusable, with no keyboard handling
en.verdictOverridden: Overrides the official geometry: 44 tall, 22 radius, 16px type
en.verdictSwitch: A hand-drawn switch 44 × 24, whose aspect ratio is not 36:20
